races.name: 11th Annual Combat Cancer Walk
races.description:
Get ready to make a difference and have a blast at the 11th Annual Combat Cancer Walk hosted by Support Sisterz!

This community event is all about raising funds for women in Corona, Norco, Eastvale, and surrounding areas who are battling breast and gynecologic cancers.

This isn't just any walk—it's a community celebration! We’re honoring survivors, supporting those currently fighting cancer, and remembering those we've lost.

races.name: 2027 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.7.27
races.description:
2027 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.7.27. Started in 1978 as the Human Race Triathlon, Cal Tri Newport Dunes is the longest running triathlon in the world operating from the same location. Also started in 1978 was the Ironman World Championship Triathlon Oahu but it moved to Kailua-Kona, Hawaii in 1981. This serves as the Cal Tri Events National Championship Race with registration in the 1500-2000 range.
